miss_rate.value: 38/126 = 30.2% (verified; both auditors); up to 46/134 = 34.3% with 8 unverified
miss_rate.note: The blind list audit ran in parallel with the finders this time, so every verified miss was added before profiling was chosen. Two-list (capture-recapture) estimate of the population the auditors' search methods reach: about 132 plants; auditor A found 93 and auditor B 94 of the ledger's included plants, 66 in common. The ledger's included plants contain all of them plus suppliers and fabricators outside the auditors' search angles. Misses were mostly small attachment and bucket makers, paving machine makers, aggregate equipment makers and mining service fabricators. A first closure pass then added 14 more base plants (11 from EPA's mining-machinery registry), so the list has not converged; a second closure pass is running.

known_limits: Profiled and scored, but not yet fact-checked: the round-1 fact-check of all 40 profiles is running.

Material scores 0 on 38 of 40 profiled plants: mining and construction sources rarely state a welded part's size or weight, and payloads, bucket capacities and machine classes do not count as part sizes. Most strong plants therefore land in Medium (53-68).
EPA FRS was down (503) during parts of the finder stage; some registry quotes were checked only by the finders.
